console.empty.title: Agent console
error.GIT_AUTH_FAILED.hint: The repository token is missing or invalid. Reconnect the Git provider to refresh the token.
error.GIT_AUTH_FAILED.title: Git authentication failed
error.GIT_PERMISSION_DENIED.hint: The token does not have write access to this repository. Grant push permission or reconnect with the right scopes.
error.GIT_PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Git push permission denied
error.GIT_WORKFLOW_SCOPE.hint: The task edited .github/workflows but the token lacks the workflow OAuth scope. Reconnect GitHub to grant it, then rerun.
error.GIT_WORKFLOW_SCOPE.title: Missing GitHub "workflow" scope
error.LLM_AUTH_FAILED.hint: The LLM provider rejected the API key. Update the key or switch to a working config, then rerun the task.
error.LLM_AUTH_FAILED.title: LLM API key is invalid or unauthorized
error.LLM_CONNECTION_FAILED.hint: The LLM base URL is unreachable (DNS, network, or firewall). Check the base URL and server availability.
error.LLM_CONNECTION_FAILED.title: Cannot connect to the LLM endpoint
error.LLM_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.hint: The LLM provider reports insufficient quota. Add billing credits on the provider side or switch to a different config.
error.LLM_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: LLM quota or billing limit exceeded
error.LLM_RATE_LIMITED.hint: Too many requests were sent to the LLM provider. Wait a moment and rerun, or reduce the requests-per-minute in the config.
error.LLM_RATE_LIMITED.title: LLM rate limit reached
error.LLM_SERVER_ERROR.hint: The provider is experiencing issues (HTTP 5xx). Retry shortly; if it persists, check the provider status page.
error.LLM_SERVER_ERROR.title: The LLM provider returned a server error
error.LLM_TIMEOUT.hint: The provider did not respond within the timeout. Increase the timeout in the LLM config or retry.
error.LLM_TIMEOUT.title: The LLM request timed out
error.PROPOSAL_GENERATION_FAILED.hint: The background pipeline could not generate proposals after multiple retries. Check the LLM config and try again, or trigger proposals manually.
error.PROPOSAL_GENERATION_FAILED.title: Autonomous proposal generation failed
error.UNKNOWN.hint: Check the console log below for details. If the issue persists, retry the task.
error.UNKNOWN.title: Task failed with an unexpected error
